#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)

if [ "$#" -ne 1 ]; then
    printf 'usage: %s RELEASE_DIRECTORY\n' "$0" >&2
    exit 64
fi

release=$1
case $release in
    /*) release_path=$release ;;
    *)  release_path=$base/$release ;;
esac

if [ ! -d "$release_path" ]; then
    printf 'publish: release directory not found: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 66
fi

if [ ! -f "$release_path/MANIFEST" ]; then
    printf 'publish: refusing release without MANIFEST: %s\n' "$release" >&2
    exit 65
fi

# Build the replacement beside current so the final rename is on one filesystem.
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d "$base/.publish.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
    rm -f "$tmpdir/current"
    rmdir "$tmpdir" 2>/dev/null || :
}
trap 'cleanup' 0
trap 'exit 1' HUP INT TERM

ln -s -- "$release" "$tmpdir/current"
# rename(2) replaces the old symlink atomically: current is never absent.
mv -Tf -- "$tmpdir/current" "$base/current"
